claim: Implemented a single-pass online-softmax attention kernel with one 256-thread block per query row, warp-shuffle plus shared-memory dot-product reduction, shared query staging, and coalesced strided Q/K/V/O accesses.
expected_effects: fuse score, stable softmax, and value accumulation into one kernel
improve query reuse across all key positions
risk: large per-row shared-memory allocation for unusually large head_dim
one-block-per-row parallelism may limit occupancy for small workloads
